nonblocking_findings.title: Earlier M0 unchanged claims contradict the final validator changes
nonblocking_findings.evidence: At fixed head inventory/main.go adds universal host-namespace and resource destination checks, platform.go moves its host check, scan-gate/render.go adds LOCAL-HOST-NAMESPACE. The guide still says unchanged M0 full PodSpec inventory and M0 validators unchanged; the Python docstring repeats it. The later attempt3 section correctly explains the changes.
nonblocking_findings.reproduction: git diff bc6adaedcd645a4663c23284b977a3dd36c0796d 41a7e9632102a8c30ff7fa57570fd85aea19adf1 -- tools/inventory/main.go tools/inventory/platform.go tools/scan-gate/render.go; inspect guide lines51 and58 and Python docstring.
nonblocking_findings.impact: A reader could under-scope regression review. No runtime or gate weakening is demonstrated; the appended correction, inspected code and fresh full-scope measurements prevent reliance on this claim.
nonblocking_findings.correction: Update the earlier statements/docstring to distinguish unchanged active resources and provenance/PVC contract from strengthened Inventory/security validators. Any changed head requires Manager-directed revalidation.
